{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页搜索提供方插件：把内置 web_search 工具接到 OpenAI 兼容 Responses API 及其原生 web_search 工具上。","id":"gh:1356221603","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-web-search-diy","slug":"aaronlei/dsh-web-search-diy","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-web-search","dsh-web-search-diy"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页搜索提供方插件：把内置 web_search 工具接到 OpenAI 兼容 Responses API 及其原生 web_search 工具上。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-web-search-diy"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> A **web search provider plugin** for the **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. It supplies the built-in `web"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"_search` tool per **vendor × protocol**: three in-protocol shapes (Chat Completions / Responses / An"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"thropic Messages) plus standalone search, covering DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu, Qwen, OpenAI, Anthropic, O"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"penRouter, and four custom targets. Results are normalized into **structured citation sources** for "},{"id":"p4s5","text":"the calling model to ground its answer on. The plugin also ships an observability page that records "},{"id":"p4s6","text":"every search and can backfill history from older session logs."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Capabilities"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- 🧭 **Vendor × protocol matrix** — 17 official targets (13 full + 4 degraded) and 4 custom targets. "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"Only combinations that really search appear in the vendor list; the rest live in a collapsed section"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" with a reason.
- 🎛️ **Three-layer configuration page** — search kind → protocol → vendor. Fields co"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"me from the catalog served by the host; a blank value means the combination's default.
- 🧩 **Custom "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"targets** — a template picker performs a one-shot fill (selection resets, nothing is saved); endpoin"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"t, path, request field names, and response field names are all editable.
- 🧪 **Test connection** — r"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"uns one real search with the staged draft (nothing saved to the configuration) and grades the result"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" by source quality.
- 🔐 **Write-only credentials** — API keys are stored through the credentials ser"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"vice, never in the configuration file; each vendor offers its reference chain.
- 🗂️ **Configuration "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"v3** — one bucket per `vendor/protocol`; v1/v2 files migrate on read and the old file is backed up a"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"s `.v2.bak` before the first save.
- 🪜 **Thinking-effort fallback** — a rejected `reasoning.effort` "},{"id":"p6s12","text":"/ `output_config` / `thinking` is dropped one at a time and retried.
- 📦 **Dispatcher-proof decoding"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"** — bodies are read as bytes and inflated by magic number, independent of dsh's global undici dispa"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"tcher.
- 📄 **Long bodies become source summaries** — standalone search writes its long body into `so"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"urce.summary` (capped at 2,000 characters) and skips it when the original body equals `snippet`; sni"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"ppets are capped the same way. The model reads the summary before falling back to the snippet.
- 🚦 *"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"*No credential, no tool** — when the selected target cannot resolve a credential, `web_search` is no"},{"id":"p6s18","text":" longer offered to the model instead of failing after invocation.
- 📊 **Built-in observability page*"},{"id":"p6s19","text":"* — a first-level "Config / Observability" tab. The overview shows searches, success rate, P50/P95, "},{"id":"p6s20","text":"average sources, summary coverage, a target ranking, success-rate/P95 trends and recent records; the"},{"id":"p6s21","text":" records view filters by status and query, expands source details, and copies a record as JSON.

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Capability matrix"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Legend: ✅ full (in-protocol search + citable sources); ◐ degraded (searches, but sources or model ar"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"e limited); ✗ unsupported; ⚙ custom."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Vendor | Chat Completions | Responses | Anthropic Messages | Standalone search |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| DeepSeek | ✗ | ◐ `deepseek-v4-pro` only; sources from `open_page` | ✅ | ✅ `/v1/tools/search` |
| K"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"imi | ✗ built-in `$web_search` retired | ✅ `web_search` + `include` | ✗ no server tool in the schema"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" | ✅ `/v1/tools/search` |
| Zhipu | ✅ `web_search` tool | ✅ `web_search` + `results[]` | ✗ accepts b"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ut does not run it | ✅ `/paas/v4/web_search` |
| Qwen | ◐ `enable_search`, no sources | ✅ `action.so"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"urces` (url only) | ✅ needs the billing header | ✗ no standalone REST |
| OpenAI | ◐ `gpt-5-search-a"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"pi` only | ✅ full `filters` / `include` | ✗ no such endpoint | ✗ |
| Anthropic | ✗ | ✗ | ✅ native `w"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"eb_search` | ✗ |
| OpenRouter | ✅ `openrouter:web_search` | ✅ same server tool | ◐ alias, untested |"},{"id":"p10s8","text":" ✗ |
| Custom | ⚙ template + 4 variants | ⚙ template + `toolType` | ⚙ template + `toolType` | ⚙ temp"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"late + 8 mapping fields |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> 13 full, 4 degraded (OpenRouter Anthropic is pending), 4 custom. Eight `unsupported` entries exist"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" only for the collapsed section and never create a configuration bucket."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Kimi Chat is not wired in**: the in-protocol `$web_search` retires on 2026-10-20, and the `api.k"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"imi.com/coding` endpoint is not wired either. Kimi keeps Responses and standalone search (`/v1/tools"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"/search`; the Pro endpoint can be reached by overriding `path` on a custom target).
- **Zhipu's Anth"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ropic surface accepts but never runs the tool** (`web_search_requests: 0`), so it is marked unsuppor"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ted.
- **DeepSeek Responses only works with `deepseek-v4-pro`** and returns no `action.sources`; sou"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"rces come from `open_page` only.
- **Qwen Chat returns no sources**; Qwen is wired to the Qwen AI Pl"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"atform only (`maas.qianwenaiapi.com`), not Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.
- **OpenAI Chat only works wi"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"th `gpt-5-search-api`**; ordinary models ignore the tool.
- **OpenRouter Anthropic** accepts the `we"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"b_search_20250305` alias per its docs, but it is not verified yet.
- **Kimi Responses** rejects `sea"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"rch_context_size` / `blocked_domains` (400).
- **Standalone search has no model turn**; its output c"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"ap is `digestEntries` / `digestSnippetChars`, not a model token budget.
- **Standalone source text i"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"s capped** at 2,000 characters for both `snippet` and `summary`, without splitting surrogate pairs; "},{"id":"p13s13","text":"`dsh-tool-web` then trims `summary` to 800 by default before the model reads it.
- **Test connection"},{"id":"p13s14","text":" uses a fixed query** (`OpenAI`) and only proves connectivity, not search quality.
- **Observability"},{"id":"p13s15","text":" requires `node:sqlite`** — when the module is missing, the directory is unwritable, or the database"},{"id":"p13s16","text":" is corrupt, the whole observability layer is disabled with one diagnostic; search is unaffected.
- "},{"id":"p13s17","text":"**The observation store keeps the latest 50,000 rows** — retention is not time-based, and imported h"},{"id":"p13s18","text":"istory shares the same cap.
- **Historical import can only recover calls present in session logs** —"},{"id":"p13s19","text":" an older session with neither a request event nor an endpoint matching a catalog default keeps the "},{"id":"p13s20","text":"`historical` target; re-running the import does not change it.
- **Test and compare records are excl"},{"id":"p13s21","text":"uded by default** — enable "Include test connections" in the toolbar to count them. Test connections"},{"id":"p13s22","text":" always use the fixed `OpenAI` query.
